This page is named “The Emperor (V) (Virtual Set 19)” because [[The Emperor]] (Decipher) and [[The Emperor (V)]] (Virtual Block 3) already exist.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Card image published 9 March 2026, and the current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set19Type.html Virtual Set 19 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual19-Dark/large/theemperor.gif</code> as published 9 March 2026: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/large/theemperor.gif holotable commit 6f23e07] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “Never deploys or moves (even if carried) to a site opponent occupies. Immune to attrition.” '''What changed:''' Game text: “Destiny +1 for each Black Sun agent or Jedi on table (limit +5) when drawn for destiny. Deploys only to Coruscant.” was removed; “May cancel Projection” became “Players do not retrieve Force for initiating a battle. While Agents”; “A Skywalker here.” became “Black Sun on table, your total battle destiny is +1 where you have a Black Sun agent.”. destiny changed from 1 to 6. The title changed from “•The Emperor” to “•The Emperor, Relentless” (a title change is a version: Bill, 9 November 2026). Destiny changed from 1 to 6.
